sloka: यस्य प्रमाणाद्विपुलं प्रमाणं नेह विद्यते ।दिष्ट्या ते समरे राम कुम्भकर्णो निपातितः ।। ७.१.२२ ॥
transliteration: yasya pramāṇādvipulaṁ pramāṇaṁ neha vidyate ।diṣṭyā te samare rāma kumbhakarṇo nipātitaḥ ।। 7.1.22 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, it is by good fortune that you have struck down Kumbhakarna in battle, whose immense size has no equal in this world.
